title: Hosted zone affinity enforcer and retention evidence harvester
creator: Lena Park
description: Objective: Implement a hosted-API feature that enforces 'zone affinity' (soft and hard modes) for tenant request routing, exposes retention settings per-tenant, and automates generation of cryptographic-ready evidence bundles for audits. The feature should let tenants opt for: 1) Soft affinity (prefer region but allow fallback with logged exceptions), 2) Hard affinity (route only to pinned region(s) and fail/queue requests if unavailable), 3) Retention profile (TTL, auto-delete, archived flag). Acceptance criteria: - API flags for region_affinity and retention_profile documented in API spec. - Console UX for configuring affinity and retention with clear SLO effects. - Evidence harvester produces per-tenant bundle with routing logs, retention TTL changes, and signed snapshot compatible with compliance reviewers. - Automated nightly evidence export to tenant storage (S3/GC) and on-demand export endpoint. Constraints: - Must preserve low-latency SLO for P0 traffic; soft affinity should not add >10ms median latency. - Compatible with Dedicated and Private later; initial rollout hosted-only. - Integration with KMS for bundle signing and with audit log pipeline required.
acceptance_criteria: API: new fields region_affinity (soft|hard|none) and retention_profile (name, ttl_days, archived) added to tenant config and schema; validated in API contract
Console: settings page with previews of expected routing behavior and estimated SLO change; rollout toggle (preview->enforce)
Evidence: harvester emits signed tar.gz containing routing logs (last 90 days), retention policy change events, and hash manifest; upload to configured bucket and make downloadable from Console
Telemetry: new metrics tenant.region_fallback_rate, tenant.retention_policy_changes, evidence_export_status; baseline dashboards and alerts
Security: KMS signing key rotation support and access control enforced for evidence download
design_notes: Chose 'zone' over 'region' in UI to allow future finer-grained geography control
Soft affinity implemented as preference-weight in smart router rather than strict tag to avoid queueing cascade
Evidence bundle format: gzipped JSON lines + signed manifest to simplify downstream parity with auditors
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (hosted-only): API schema, router soft-affinity weight, retention_profile CRUD, Console MVP, harvester nightly job, KMS signing
Phase 2: Hard-affinity enforcement mode with graceful queueing and tenant-visible error codes; on-demand evidence export API; SLA pages update
Phase 3: Dedicated & Private compatibility, e2e tests, performance tuning and rollout
risks: Hard-affinity could increase error surface during regional outages; need fallback policy and customer communication
Evidence harvesters may produce large bundles for high-traffic tenants — cost and storage budgeting required
Retention changes interact with caching/KV layer; must ensure deletion is enforced across caches and backup pipelines
test_plan: Unit tests for API validation and retention enforcement
Integration test: simulate region outage and validate soft/hard affinity behavior
E2E: evidence generation and signature verification; download and verify manifest
Load test: measure latency impact of soft-affinity routing under 99th percentile traffic
